lessons.title: Practice NULL CASE Statements
lessons.description: Add a price_tier column with CASE: Budget when price is below 50, otherwise Premium. The test checks that the result has at least 5 rows and a column named price_tier.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: add a price_tier column: 'Budget' under 50, otherwise 'Premium'
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN 'Budget' ELSE 'Premium' END AS price_tier FROM products;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — The CASE expression — WHEN/THEN/ELSE branches

learning_objectives: Depot potters recount crates before dawn, and handle missing data NULL is not a value but a marker for 'no data'.

hints: Read the one job this step is practicing.
The example is about NULL CASE Statements.
CASE WHEN salary >= 100000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'mid' END

exercises.question: Depot potters recount crates before dawn. For handle missing data NULL is not a value but a marker for 'no data', which line labels a salary with CASE?
hints: Compare each line with the example.
One line matches the example.

exercises.explanation: CASE picks high when the salary is at least 100000.
